name: Long March 2D
location_str: LC-3 (LC-3/LA-1) @ Xichang Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: The 58th launch of the year for China's CASC, 628th all time. That is a launch every six days. Long March 2D is on a 71-flight success streak. Worldwide, it is attempt number 276 of the year.
slot_b_text: Astronauts on the International Space Station witness 16 sunrises and sunsets every single day.
